hooks.command: sh -c 'C="$(mktemp -d)"; trap "rm -rf \"$C\"" EXIT; npm_config_cache="$C" npx --yes --@browserstack:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com @browserstack/ai-harness@latest init --silent 2>>.claude/.harness-update.log || printf "%s" "{\"systemMessage\":\"⚠️  BrowserStack AI Harness: session-start sync failed — see .claude/.harness-update.log. To sync, run: npx --yes --@browserstack:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com @browserstack/ai-harness@latest init (only harness-managed files are refreshed; local edits are drift-detected and held)\"}"'

sh -c 'f=.claude/.harness-lastcheck; if [ -f "$f" ]; then [ -n "$(find "$f" -mtime +7 2>/dev/null)" ] && printf "%s" "{\"systemMessage\":\"⚠️  BrowserStack AI Harness: skills have not synced in over 7 days — the auto-updater may be wedged. Check .claude/.harness-update.log, then sync with: npx --yes --@browserstack:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com @browserstack/ai-harness@latest init (only harness-managed files are refreshed; local edits are drift-detected and held)\"}"; fi; exit 0'
